summary: Cycurion, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the entry into exchange and restructuring agreements with three noteholders (IQ Financial, M2B Funding Corp., Obsidian Associates). Outstanding debt and default-related amounts were exchanged for new convertible promissory notes and Series H Convertible Preferred Stock. Specific terms: IQ Financial exchanged ~$517,604 for a new note; M2B exchanged ~$1.33M principal for a note convertible at $1.05/share and ~$953K in preferred convertible at $1.45/share; Obsidian exchanged ~$1.08M for a new note and ~$947K in preferred. No price per share, premium, or deal value is stated. The filing is a routine debt restructuring, not a special situation.
